correctness.rationale: For any finite even-even generalized octagon, the girth sixteen and odd vertex degrees establish the nine distance-shell identities. Since all nine shells are nonempty and disjoint they form a cyclic degree-nine witness and the exact adjacency minimal polynomial X^7(X+1)^2. Temporal module identities convert the maximal zero and one blocks to exact orders sixteen and six, with lcm forty-eight. The explicit quotient gives all divisors as least periods. The fixed-space exponent uses modular Jordan kernels and Möbius inversion; both independent standalone scripts replay and agree on all divisor cases. No unproved graph enumeration is used.

value.rationale: A full family of largest-gon finite incidence geometries acquires a sharp reversible dynamical period independent of group realization or graph size, while its orbit multiplicities retain meaningful modular-incidence-rank information. The exact all-divisor spectrum and octagon-vs-hexagon dyadic clock plateau, despite different longest Jordan chain lengths, is a structural phenomenon. This is a natural complete temporal classification for the octagon class, not an arbitrary finite-table calculation.
